summary: Iteration 2 (4 new features) tested. Backend: 17 NEW tests for /api/palette, /api/templates CRUD, /api/templates/{id}/like, /api/templates/{id}/apply — ALL 17 PASS. Full regression 43/43 passing (26 existing + 17 new). Frontend: dashboard climate banner ('CLIMATE FIT · WARM' with 26°C tropical/linen advice for Tokyo) + BROWSE TEMPLATES button render correctly. /templates lists all 4 official templates (Tokyo, Bali, Lisbon, Reykjavík) with climate chip + likes + colour swatches. /templates/[id] shows description + 9-item recipe + Like button (heart turns sage on tap, visible 'Liked' label) + APPLY TO MY TRIP. Grid screen renders 9 slots + 12 drag-items in drawer + GENERATE 27 OUTFITS enabled at 9/9.

minor.issue: Apply re-clones items every call without checking if the trip's existing grid items were also from a previous template apply. Repeated applies will balloon wardrobe (9 new items per call) and orphan the previously-cloned items. Consider clearing previously cloned 'from-template' items for the same trip on re-apply, or warn the user.
No idempotency / per-user dedup — same authenticated user can spam likes by tapping repeatedly. Consider a 'liked_by: [user_ids]' set to prevent double-counts.
Pillow.Image.open without size limit — a malicious large base64 (decompression bomb) could exhaust memory. Consider Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS guard or max byte length on payload.image.

ui_bugs.component: templates/[id].tsx APPLY flow on web preview
ui_bugs.issue: Alert.alert with multi-button confirm does not work on react-native-web — Alert.alert reduces to a single-button window.alert and the 'Apply' onPress callback never fires. Apply works fine on native iOS/Android Expo Go, but is broken in the web preview the user sees from the dashboard. Consider wrapping the confirm in a custom in-app Modal so it works on all platforms.

On 390-px wide viewport after applying Tokyo template, only 2 of 3 columns (TOP/BOTTOM) render visibly; LAYER (3rd column) items are present in DOM (all 9 names visible in body innerText, slots grid-slot-0..8 all exist, dashboard shows 9/9) but visually cropped/off-screen. Likely a flex/min-width sizing bug in the slot grid container — third column may overflow horizontally on narrow phones.

integration_issues.issue: Because the web Alert.alert dropping the buttons, the apply API is never called from the web preview, the user is not redirected to /(tabs)/grid, and nothing visibly happens when tapping APPLY TO MY TRIP. Backend apply itself works (verified via pytest).

issues: Card looks great. CLIMATE chip uses lowercase ('cold','warm','tropical','cool') text rendered in uppercase via styling — confirmed visually clear.
After Like, button shows 'Liked' with heart icon coloured sage as expected — clear visual feedback.
CLIMATE FIT banner uses warning tone and renders the climate label + advice line clearly. Colour treatment matches priority (warm = warning amber, ok = sage).

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-web's Alert.alert only supports single-button alert; multi-button confirm patterns silently drop the action buttons. Use a custom Modal+Pressable for cross-platform confirms.

action_items: Replace native Alert.alert in /app/frontend/app/templates/[id].tsx with a custom Modal-based confirm so the Apply flow works on web preview (currently broken on web; fine on native).

Fix grid-slot LAYER column cropping/overflow on 390px viewport in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/grid.tsx — check flexBasis / column widths / horizontal padding so all 3 columns are visible on small phones.
Add idempotency to POST /api/templates/{id}/like (per-user dedup) — prevents repeated taps from inflating likes.
Add cleanup for previously cloned 'from-template' wardrobe items when re-applying a template to the same trip (otherwise wardrobe grows by 9 every apply).
Add image-size guard on POST /api/palette to prevent decompression-bomb DOS.
critical_code_review_comments: Server.py is now ~595 lines and includes templates + palette + auth + trips + wardrobe + weather all in one file. Consider splitting into routers/{auth,wardrobe,trips,templates,palette,weather}.py once it crosses 700 lines.

Seed templates have a useful pattern (top/bottom/layer cycle) that aligns with the grid layout — but the apply_template endpoint silently truncates to first 9 (`tpl['items'][:9]`); if a user-published template ever drifts to >9 items the publish validator (==9) would already reject so the slice is dead-code defensive. Fine, but add a comment.
POST /api/palette catches all exceptions and returns 400 — log the actual exception so production debugging is easier.

Apply endpoint sets weight_kg=0.3 hard-coded for cloned items even if the source template item had different weight. Currently TemplateItem doesn't carry weight_kg — consider adding it for accurate pack weight projections.

rca_of_issue: Apply-on-web bug RCA: react-native-web's Alert.alert implementation maps to window.alert (single button) and discards the buttons[] config — so the second button's onPress (which triggers POST /api/templates/{id}/apply + router.replace) is never invoked. Reproduction: open /templates/<official-id> on web preview, tap APPLY TO MY TRIP, observe a single-button alert appear and dismiss it; URL stays on /templates/<id> and no /api/templates/{id}/apply request is fired. Mitigation: replace Alert.alert with a custom confirm Modal (cross-platform) OR detect Platform.OS==='web' and use window.confirm('Apply this template?').
